$description: Foreground/background token pairs the design promises. min is the WCAG 2.2 ratio in light and dark; hc-min in high-contrast. Text pairs are 4.5 / 7; UI marks 3 / 3. Deliberately absent, with the measured numbers on record: rule (1.47:1) and rule-strong (1.86:1 light) are decorative hairlines; flow/stream/batch are filled marks and sit at 4.0–4.2:1 light, so they are promised at 3:1 and never used as body text; warn-solid is 2.67:1 on the light page and is a dot, never a surface for text (OverviewSub's split bar paints on-signal text on it today -- recorded as debt in DESIGN.md, not waived here). The scrim pair is the regression that made a dark dialog vanish at 1.07:1; its floor is a perceivable step, not a WCAG number.
